items.html: And so it is found that the two aspects of Atik Yomin, namely the male and the female, coupled together, and raised the five lower parts of the Keter of Ban, in the secret of Mayin Nukvin; they clarified them, both among the lights and among the aspect of the vessels, and they were there in the aspect of gestation for twelve months, and there Arich Anpin was corrected.
